tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Use for match results by day, tournament or season: each match with both players, seeds, round, status, score and sets (games and tiebreak points). Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), a tournament_id or a season; filter by round (e.g. "Final") and status. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoin

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for upcoming matches: every scheduled or in-progress singles match in the next N days (default 7, max 30) with players, seeds, round and start time where one is set. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoint pass league: "wta" for the WTA. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Use for everything about one match: the score by set with tiebreak points, seeds, each player's sets, games and tiebreaks won, both players' ratings before and after (overall and on the surface), what the score says (total games, tiebreaks, whether it went the distance, comebacks), and each sportsbo

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Use to find a player's id. Search by name (accents optional) and/or country code (e.g. ITA); most-played first, with matches, last match and rank on the current list (null outside the top 100 to 150 listed). Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoint pass league: "wta" for the WTA. Costs 1 c

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Use for a player profile: date of birth, country, height, playing hand; latest ranking; our rating overall and per surface with peak; career record (wins, losses, sets, games, tiebreaks, deciding sets), titles, finals and Grand Slam titles; record by surface; and the last 10 matches. Tour: atp (defa

tools.name: get_player_matches
tools.description: Use for a player's matches, newest first: tournament, surface, round, opponent, result, score by set and the player's rating before and after. Filter by season, surface, opponent_id, tournament_id or draw. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoint pass league: "wta" for the WTA. Costs 5 cre

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Use for two players' head to head: wins each, sets won, wins by surface and in finals, and every meeting with its score. Walkovers are listed but not counted as wins; incomplete records are not counted. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoint pass league: "wta" for the WTA. Costs 3 credit

tools.name: get_surface_splits
tools.description: Use for a player's record by surface (hard, clay, grass, carpet): wins, losses, win rate, sets, share of games won, tiebreaks, deciding sets and 6-0 sets, plus the current surface ratings. For one season or the whole career; by_season splits each surface by year. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the s

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Use for a player's match statistics by season: wins, losses, sets and games won, tiebreaks won and lost, deciding sets, 6-0 sets and retirements, all counted from scores; plus the record by round and by the opponent's ranking (top 10, 11-50, 51-100). No serve statistics: they are not available. Tour

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: Use for the ranking list: the latest (default), or a season and week, or the list in force on a date, with rank, previous rank, points and player. Pass player_id instead for one player's ranking history. Weekly lists hold the top 100 to 150 for most weeks since 2007. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on t

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for our Elo ratings, highest first: overall, or on one surface (hard, clay, grass). Players with a rated match since active_since (default a year ago) and at least 10 rated matches. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoint pass league: "wta" for the WTA. Costs 2 credits.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_schedule" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Costs 2 credits." → after: "Use for upcoming matches: every scheduled or in-progress singles match in the next N days (default 7, max 30) with players, seeds, round and start time where one is set. Tour: atp (default) or wta; on the shared endpoint pass league: "wta" for the WTA. Costs 2 credits."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
